name: tokens
title: cmplt 3-Tier OKLCH & Liquid Typography Tokens
author: Patrick Schrödter (ptrckschrdtr) <https://ptrckschrdtr.de>
description: 3-tier primitive & semantic OKLCH color tokens, Dual-Scale Liquid Utopia typography (Geist Variable & Geist Mono), and ch measure guardrails.

files.content:
{
  "$schema": "https://tr.designtokens.org/format/",
  "meta": {
    "name": "cmplt design system",
    "version": "1.2.0",
    "inventor": "Patrick Schrödter (ptrckschrdtr)",
    "owner": "Patrick Schrödter (ptrckschrdtr)",
    "website": "https://ptrckschrdtr.de",
    "github": "https://github.com/schroepa",
    "engine": "W3C DTCG + Calibrated OKLCH (Warm Alabaster & Matte Graphite)",
    "modes": ["Light", "Dark"],
    "presets": ["precision", "editorial", "emerald"]
  },
  "color": {
    "primitive": {
      "neutral": {
        "0": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.992 0.001 85)", "hexFallback": "#fdfdfc" },
        "25": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.985 0.002 85)", "hexFallback": "#fbfbf9" },
        "50": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.968 0.002 85)", "hexFallback": "#f5f5f3" },
        "100": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.950 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#eeeeec" },
        "200": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.922 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#e5e5e3" },
        "300": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.882 0.004 85)", "hexFallback": "#dadad7" },
        "400": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.745 0.004 85)", "hexFallback": "#adadaa" },
        "500": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.635 0.004 85)", "hexFallback": "#8b8b88" },
        "600": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.510 0.004 85)", "hexFallback": "#666663" },
        "700": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.360 0.004 85)", "hexFallback": "#3d3d3b" },
        "750": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.332 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#353534" },
        "800": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.304 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#2e2e2d" },
        "850": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.286 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#2a2a29" },
        "900": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.270 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#262625" },
        "950": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.242 0.003 85)", "hexFallback": "#1f1f1e" }
      },
      "brand": {
        "50": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.962 0.02 35)", "hexFallback": "#fdf0ed" },
        "100": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.93 0.04 35)", "hexFallback": "#fbe0d9" },
        "200": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.87 0.075 35)", "hexFallback": "#f6c2b4" },
        "300": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.78 0.12 35)", "hexFallback": "#f09982" },
        "400": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.69 0.165 35)", "hexFallback": "#ec7657" },
        "500": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.645 0.175 34)", "hexFallback": "#ea623f" },
        "600": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.585 0.17 34)", "hexFallback": "#d44f2d" },
        "700": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.515 0.115 162)", "hexFallback": "#007a5a" },
        "800": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.57 0.19 275)", "hexFallback": "#5e5ce6" },
        "900": { "$type": "color", "$value": "oklch(0.35 0.09 34)", "hexFallback": "#5c2516" }
      }
    },
    "semantic": {
      "bg.canvas": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--bg-canvas",
        "tailwindClass": "bg-canvas",
        "light": "#eeeeec (oklch 0.950)",
        "dark": "#1f1f1e (oklch 0.242)",
        "$description": "Soft warm stone (Light) / Matte graphite (Dark) canvas — never pure white or black",
        "figmaScope": ["FRAME_FILL"]
      },
      "bg.surface": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--bg-surface",
        "tailwindClass": "bg-surface",
        "light": "#fbfbf9 (oklch 0.985)",
        "dark": "#262625 (oklch 0.270)",
        "$description": "Primary card shell surface",
        "figmaScope": ["FRAME_FILL", "SHAPE_FILL"]
      },
      "bg.elevated": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--bg-elevated",
        "tailwindClass": "bg-elevated",
        "light": "#fdfdfc (oklch 0.992)",
        "dark": "#2e2e2d (oklch 0.304)",
        "$description": "Nested inner panel ('Product Design' pane) & floating overlays",
        "figmaScope": ["FRAME_FILL"]
      },
      "bg.subtle": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--bg-subtle",
        "tailwindClass": "bg-subtle",
        "light": "#f5f5f3 (oklch 0.968)",
        "dark": "#2a2a29 (oklch 0.286)",
        "$description": "Left sidebar pane (Light) & inset grouped key-value boxes (Dark)",
        "figmaScope": ["FRAME_FILL", "SHAPE_FILL"]
      },
      "bg.accent": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--bg-accent",
        "tailwindClass": "bg-accent",
        "light": "#ea623f (Warm Coral)",
        "dark": "#007a5a (Forest Jade)",
        "$description": "Primary action surface ('Done' Coral pill in Light, 'Accept' Jade button in Dark)",
        "figmaScope": ["FRAME_FILL", "SHAPE_FILL"]
      },
      "fg.primary": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--fg-primary",
        "tailwindClass": "text-fg-primary",
        "light": "#1f1f1e (oklch 0.242)",
        "dark": "#e4e4e2 (oklch 0.915)",
        "$description": "Soft charcoal (Light) & warm off-white (Dark) primary text",
        "figmaScope": ["TEXT_FILL", "SHAPE_FILL"]
      },
      "fg.secondary": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--fg-secondary",
        "tailwindClass": "text-fg-secondary",
        "light": "#666663 (oklch 0.510)",
        "dark": "#a9a9a6 (oklch 0.735)",
        "$description": "Supporting descriptions and secondary values",
        "figmaScope": ["TEXT_FILL"]
      },
      "fg.muted": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--fg-muted",
        "tailwindClass": "text-fg-muted",
        "light": "#8b8b88 (oklch 0.635)",
        "dark": "#858582 (oklch 0.615)",
        "$description": "Key-value labels ('Hourly Rate', 'Location') and section headers",
        "figmaScope": ["TEXT_FILL"]
      },
      "border.subtle": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--border-subtle",
        "tailwindClass": "border-border-subtle",
        "light": "#e5e5e3 (oklch 0.922)",
        "dark": "#353534 (oklch 0.332)",
        "$description": "Delicate 1px row dividers inside grouped lists and cards",
        "figmaScope": ["STROKE_COLOR"]
      },
      "border.default": {
        "$type": "color",
        "cssVar": "--border-default",
        "tailwindClass": "border-border-default",
        "light": "#dadad7 (oklch 0.882)",
        "dark": "#3d3d3b (oklch 0.360)",
        "$description": "Card contours, search fields, and grouped table borders",
        "figmaScope": ["STROKE_COLOR"]
      }
    }
  },
  "radius": {
    "xs": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "0.375rem", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-xs", "px": "6px" },
    "sm": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "0.5rem", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-sm", "px": "8px" },
    "md": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "0.625rem", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-md", "px": "10px" },
    "lg": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "1.25rem", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-lg", "px": "20px" },
    "xl": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "1.5rem", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-xl", "px": "24px" },
    "full": { "$type": "dimension", "$value": "9999px", "cssVar": "--cmplt-radius-full", "px": "9999px" }
  },
  "typography": {
    "fontFamily": {
      "sans": {
        "$type": "fontFamily",
        "$value": "Geist Variable",
        "cssVar": "--font-geist-sans",
        "tailwindClass": "font-sans",
        "weights": "100–900 (Variable wght axis)",
        "darkOpticalOffset": "-15 to -20 wght (Anti-Halation)"
      },
      "mono": {
        "$type": "fontFamily",
        "$value": "Geist Mono Variable",
        "cssVar": "--font-geist-mono",
        "tailwindClass": "font-mono",
        "weights": "100–900 (Variable wght axis)",
        "features": "tabular-nums, zero, calt"
      }
    },
    "scaleEngine": {
      "strategy": "Dual-Scale Liquid Utopia (clamp) + Static UI Separation",
      "viewportMin": "360px",
      "viewportMax": "1440px",
      "ratioMin": "1.200 (Minor Third)",
      "ratioMax": "1.333 (Perfect Fourth)"
    },
    "liquidScale": {
      "display-xl": {
        "step": "Step 6",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-6",
        "tailwindClass": "text-display-xl",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-display-xl",
        "minPx": 42,
        "maxPx": 76,
        "clamp": "clamp(2.625rem, 1.8523rem + 3.1481vw, 4.75rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.04",
        "tracking": "-0.035em",
        "weight": "600 (Dark: 585)",
        "measure": "18ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Hero statements & oversized KPI display"
      },
      "display-lg": {
        "step": "Step 5",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-5",
        "tailwindClass": "text-display-lg",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-display-lg",
        "minPx": 36,
        "maxPx": 60,
        "clamp": "clamp(2.25rem, 1.7045rem + 2.2222vw, 3.75rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.04",
        "tracking": "-0.035em",
        "weight": "600 (Dark: 585)",
        "measure": "18ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Page display headers & feature callouts"
      },
      "heading-xl": {
        "step": "Step 4 (H1)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-4",
        "tailwindClass": "text-heading-xl",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-h1",
        "minPx": 30,
        "maxPx": 47,
        "clamp": "clamp(1.875rem, 1.4886rem + 1.5741vw, 2.9375rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.14",
        "tracking": "-0.024em",
        "weight": "600 (Dark: 585)",
        "measure": "28ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Primary page headings (H1)"
      },
      "heading-lg": {
        "step": "Step 3 (H2)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-3",
        "tailwindClass": "text-heading-lg",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-h2",
        "minPx": 24,
        "maxPx": 35,
        "clamp": "clamp(1.5rem, 1.25rem + 1.0185vw, 2.1875rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.14",
        "tracking": "-0.024em",
        "weight": "600 (Dark: 585)",
        "measure": "28ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Major section headings (H2)"
      },
      "heading-md": {
        "step": "Step 2 (H3)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-2",
        "tailwindClass": "text-heading-md",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-h3",
        "minPx": 20,
        "maxPx": 26,
        "clamp": "clamp(1.25rem, 1.1136rem + 0.5556vw, 1.625rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.28",
        "tracking": "-0.015em",
        "weight": "600 (Dark: 585)",
        "measure": "28ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Sub-section & feature card headings (H3)"
      },
      "heading-sm": {
        "step": "Step 1 (H4)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-1",
        "tailwindClass": "text-heading-sm",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-h4",
        "minPx": 17,
        "maxPx": 20,
        "clamp": "clamp(1.0625rem, 0.9943rem + 0.2778vw, 1.25rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.28",
        "tracking": "-0.015em",
        "weight": "500 (Dark: 485)",
        "measure": "42ch",
        "wrap": "balance",
        "usage": "Group titles & panel headers (H4)"
      },
      "lead": {
        "step": "Step 1 (Lead)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-1",
        "tailwindClass": "text-lead",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-lead",
        "minPx": 17,
        "maxPx": 20,
        "clamp": "clamp(1.0625rem, 0.9943rem + 0.2778vw, 1.25rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.65",
        "tracking": "-0.005em",
        "weight": "400 (Dark: 380)",
        "measure": "54ch",
        "wrap": "pretty",
        "usage": "Editorial lead / deck paragraphs"
      },
      "body": {
        "step": "Step 0 (Base)",
        "cssVar": "--cmplt-step-0",
        "tailwindClass": "text-body",
        "roleClass": "cmplt-body",
        "minPx": 15,
        "maxPx": 16,
        "clamp": "clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9148rem + 0.0926vw, 1rem)",
        "lineHeight": "1.65",
        "tracking": "-0.005em",
        "weight": "400 (Dark: 380)",
        "measure": "65ch",
        "wrap": "pretty",
        "usage": "Long-form prose & primary reading copy"
      }
    },
    "uiScale": {
      "ui-lg": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-ui-lg", "tailwindClass": "text-ui-lg", "px": "15px", "rem": "0.9375rem", "usage": "Large CTA buttons & hero inputs" },
      "ui-md": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-ui-md", "tailwindClass": "text-ui-md", "px": "14px", "rem": "0.875rem", "usage": "Navigation links, dialog copy, prominent controls" },
      "ui-sm": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-ui-sm", "tailwindClass": "text-ui-sm", "px": "13px", "rem": "0.8125rem", "usage": "Default buttons, form inputs, dropdown menus, table cells" },
      "ui-xs": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-ui-xs", "tailwindClass": "text-ui-xs", "px": "12px", "rem": "0.75rem", "usage": "Captions, field descriptions, uppercase section eyebrows" },
      "ui-2xs": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-ui-2xs", "tailwindClass": "text-ui-2xs", "px": "11px", "rem": "0.6875rem", "usage": "Badges, Kbd shortcuts, status pills" }
    },
    "measures": {
      "display": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-measure-display", "tailwindClass": "max-w-measure-display", "value": "18ch", "usage": "Hero headlines (2–4 words per line)" },
      "heading": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-measure-heading", "tailwindClass": "max-w-measure-heading", "value": "28ch", "usage": "Section headings H1–H3" },
      "compact": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-measure-compact", "tailwindClass": "max-w-measure-compact", "value": "42ch", "usage": "Cards, modals, sidebars & callout boxes" },
      "lead": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-measure-lead", "tailwindClass": "max-w-measure-lead", "value": "54ch", "usage": "Introductory lead paragraphs" },
      "body": { "cssVar": "--cmplt-measure-body", "tailwindClass": "max-w-measure-body", "value": "65ch", "usage": "Bringhurst ideal 60–70ch long-form reading width" }
    }
  }
}
